notes:
1. Text & Heading Decluttering: Cleaned up redundant paragraph subtitles and descriptive text beneath headings across Purchases, Customers & Parties, Accounts & Daybook, Returns, and OCR Ingestion.
2. Harsh Green Elimination & Theme Tuning: Replaced aggressive green headers and Overview tags with sophisticated slate and indigo accents, balanced dark mode contrast across inputs, tables, and dialogs.
3. Complete CRUD System: Added full Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations across Returns (Credit/Debit Note creation, editing, deletion), OCR Ingestion (line-item adding, inline editing, row removal), CSV batch importer, and Bank Statement Reconciliation (manual entry adding, matching, and deletion).
4. Middle Mouse Wheel Horizontal TopBar Scroll: Enabled direct middle-wheel mouse scrolling along the horizontal TopNav capsule bar.
5. Dual Navigation Layout Engine: Introduced instant switching between TopBar Capsule navigation and a collapsible, categorized Left Sidebar in Settings.
